name: extract-features
title: Extract features
source:
# From rows -> X (list of feature lists) and y (labels). Adds x1*x2 and standardises columns.
raw = [feat + [feat[0] * feat[1]] for feat, _ in rows]
y = [label for _, label in rows]
cols = list(zip(*raw))
means = [sum(c) / len(c) for c in cols]
stds = [max(1e-9, (sum((v - m) ** 2 for v in c) / len(c)) ** 0.5) for c, m in zip(cols, means)]
X = [[(v - m) / s for v, m, s in zip(r, means, stds)] for r in raw]
feature_names = ["x1", "x2", "x1*x2"]
print(f"{len(X)} samples x {len(feature_names)} features: {feature_names}")
description: Turns `rows` into a feature matrix `X` and labels `y`, adding one derived feature (the product of the two inputs) and standardising each column.
